text.p: Programme of soccer matches in the German first division this weekend.

Arminia Bielefeld (13) v Bochum (7). Interesting battle of promoted teams. Bielefeld, recovering after their poor start to the season, may make some changes with Dutch defender Sonny Silooy and striker Josef Ivanovic showing good form in training. Bochum, the surprise team of the season, need to win games like this to keep up challenge for UEFA Cup place.
Schalke (8) v St. Pauli (16). Schalke without U.S. international Tom Dooley on duty for his country. St. Pauli need to lift their disappointing form quickly if they want to stay in the Bundesliga.

Karlsruhe (5) v Borussia Moenchengladbach (15). Karlsruhe striker Sean Dundee doubtful because of calf injury but international midfielder Thomas Haessler should be fit to play after injury. Moenchengladbach welcome back midfielder Christian Hochstaetter after suspension.

Werder Bremen (9) v VfB Stuttgart (4). Bremen without Germany's Euro 96 star Dieter Eilts who is suspended with defender Andree Wiedener. Bremen already struggling with long-term injuries. Stuttgart also without four key players who are suspended -- Brazilian striker Giovane Elber, midfielders Matthias Hagner, Zvonimir Soldo and Gerhard Poschner.

Cologne (6) v Freiburg (18). Midfielder Ralf Hauptmann returns for home side who really should win this one if they want to keep up their challenge for place in Europe. Bottom club Freiburg have won just four games all season.

Borussia Dortmund (2) v 1860 Munich (10). Dortmund, who suffered a surprise defeat by Fortuna Duesseldorf last week, missing international midfielder Joerg Heinrich (suspension) and wing back Stefan Reuter (rib injury). 1860 also without experienced former international Manfred Schwabl (suspension).

Bayern Munich (1) v Duisburg (12). Bayern without midfielder Mehmet Scholl (calf muscle injury) who is expected to be replaced by either Christian Nerlinger or Marcel Witeczek. Leaders also have doubts about ill defender Thomas Helmer.

Fortuna Duesseldorf (14) v Bayer Leverkusen (3). Duesseldorf expected to be unchanged after last week's victory over Dortmund. Leverkusen without midfielder Claudio Reyna, also on international duty for United States.
Hamburg (11) v Hansa Rostock (17). North German battle with both teams needing points. Visitors without defender Marco Zallmann who is suspended.
